activeAero.quote: DRS was removed from Formula One for the 2026 season, and was replaced with an "active aerodynamics" system under the new 2026 regulations.

aeroTestingRestriction.quote: In 2021, the championship introduced a sliding scale system to regulate aerodynamic testing.

budgetCap.quote: The championship introduced a budget cap, with teams limited to spending a maximum of $145 million per year.
budgetCap.note: Antes de 2021 no hubo techo de gasto

drs.quote: DRS was used in Formula One from 2011 to 2025, with Jenson Button and Andrea Kimi Antonelli being the first and the last to use it, respectively.

energySystem.quote: the FIA allowed the use of 60 kW (82 PS; 80 bhp) KERS in the regulations for the 2009 Formula One season.
energySystem.note: KERS se permite por primera vez en 2009

engineFormula.note: Fórmula 3.0 atmosférico o 1.5 sobrealimentado (SRS 6.2); ningún equipo usó turbo en 1976 según f1db

engineFormulas.note: Conjunto de fórmulas de los motores de f1db; el generador aborta si no coincide

mandatoryDryCompounds.note: Sin obligación de usar dos compuestos antes de 2007 (de memoria)

parcFerme.quote: According to the FIA Formula One regulations (used since 2003), the area must be sufficiently large and secure so as to prevent unauthorised access to the cars, while allowing technical checks to take place.

pitLaneSpeed.note: Sin límite de velocidad en el pit lane antes de 1994 (conocimiento general, SIM-FISICA §4.4 NV). Valores en km/h de carrera; periodos con fecha de inicio y excepciones por id de circuito de f1db (WP6, RF-SIM-12).

pointsScheme.quote: For both the Championship and the Cup, the best seven results from rounds 1-8 and the best seven results from rounds 9-16 were counted.
pointsScheme.note: Comprobado por el generador contra los puntos de cada resultado y las clasificaciones de f1db; The International Cup for F1 Manufacturers only counted the points of the highest-finishing driver for each race.

refuelling.note: Legal hasta 1983 según la fuente, pero nadie repostaba en carrera en 1976 (Brabham lo recuperó en 1982): se modela como false. Enmienda propuesta: separar 'permitido' de 'usado'.

rule107.quote: The 107% rule was introduced for the 1996 season and remained in force until 2002.

safetyCar.quote: Formula One officially introduced safety cars in 1993, after trials were conducted at both the French and British Grands Prix during the preceding 1992 season.

sprintWeekends.note: Rondas con resultados de sprint en f1db

teamOrdersBanned.quote: After the 2002 season, FIA announced that "Team Orders that could influence the outcome of a race" were banned, although they were sometimes still implemented discreetly.

topTenStartTyres.note: Sin regla de neumático de salida para los diez primeros (de memoria)

tyreChangesInRace.quote: A major change in 2005 was the outlawing of tyre changes during pit stops.

tyreType.quote: Slick tyres were introduced to Formula One by Firestone at the 1971 Spanish Grand Prix.

unitLimits.quote: To reduce costs, a rule was introduced that each engine must last the entire race weekend.
unitLimits.note: Primer límite de motores en 2004: antes, libres

vsc.quote: The system was evolved taking into account drivers' feedback and was officially introduced for the 2015 season following ratification by the World Motor Sport Council (WMSC).

title.es: Hunt sustituye a Fittipaldi en McLaren

body.es: El campeón de 1974 se marcha al equipo de su hermano Wilson, Fittipaldi Automotive (Copersucar), y McLaren da su asiento a James Hunt.
body.en: The 1974 champion leaves for his brother Wilson's team, Fittipaldi Automotive (Copersucar), and McLaren gives his seat to James Hunt.

title.es: Jarama: Hunt gana y es descalificado por la anchura de su McLaren
title.en: Jarama: Hunt wins and is disqualified over the width of his McLaren

body.es: Los comisarios miden el coche demasiado ancho y dan la victoria a Lauda; en julio la apelación devuelve el triunfo a Hunt al considerar mínima la diferencia.
body.en: The stewards find the car too wide and hand the win to Lauda; in July an appeal gives the victory back to Hunt, judging the difference minimal.

title.es: Anderstorp: doblete del Tyrrell de seis ruedas
title.en: Anderstorp: a one-two for the six-wheeled Tyrrell

body.es: Scheckter y Depailler ganan con el P34, el único coche de seis ruedas que ha ganado un Gran Premio.
body.en: Scheckter and Depailler finish first and second in the P34, the only six-wheeled car ever to win a Grand Prix.

title.es: Brands Hatch: Hunt gana tras la salida repetida, pero el triunfo acabará en manos de Lauda
title.en: Brands Hatch: Hunt wins after the restart, but the victory will end up with Lauda

body.es: Hunt vuelve a la carrera reanudada pese a no haber completado la primera vuelta; en septiembre la FIA le retira la victoria y la da a Lauda.
body.en: Hunt takes the restart even though he had not completed the first lap; in September the FIA strips him of the win and awards it to Lauda.

title.es: Nürburgring: Lauda sufre un grave accidente con incendio
title.en: Nürburgring: Lauda suffers a serious crash and fire

body.es: Lauda sale de la pista en la segunda vuelta y su Ferrari se incendia; sufre quemaduras graves. Hunt gana la carrera reanudada.
body.en: Lauda goes off on the second lap and his Ferrari catches fire; he suffers severe burns. Hunt wins the restarted race.

title.es: Lauda no corre en Austria ni en Holanda; Ferrari no acude a Austria
title.en: Lauda misses Austria and the Netherlands; Ferrari skips Austria

body.es: Ferrari no se presenta en el Österreichring y en Zandvoort inscribe solo a Regazzoni. Watson da a Penske su única victoria en Austria.
body.en: Ferrari stays away from the Österreichring and enters only Regazzoni at Zandvoort. Watson gives Penske its only win in Austria.

title.es: Monza: Lauda vuelve seis semanas después del accidente y acaba cuarto
title.en: Monza: Lauda returns six weeks after his crash and finishes fourth

body.es: Ferrari inscribe tres coches, con Reutemann como tercero. Peterson gana con March.
body.en: Ferrari enters three cars, with Reutemann as the third. Peterson wins for March.

title.es: Fuji: Lauda se retira bajo el diluvio y Hunt es campeón por un punto
title.en: Fuji: Lauda withdraws in the downpour and Hunt is champion by one point

body.es: Lauda abandona tras dos vueltas por las condiciones; Hunt acaba tercero y gana el título. Andretti gana la carrera y Ferrari es campeón de constructores.
body.en: Lauda pulls in after two laps because of the conditions; Hunt finishes third and takes the title. Andretti wins the race and Ferrari takes the constructors' crown.
